scope: Figshare API file-level recheck for a new synchronized hydrogen-refuelling station-to-vehicle raw trace

candidate_classifications.title: Automotive solar hydrogen fuelling stations: Concept design, performance testing and evaluation
candidate_classifications.reason: The record exposes one PDF and no synchronized logger files; its rights statement does not grant raw-data reuse or redistribution.

candidate_classifications.title: CFD modelling of hydrogen safety aspects for a residential refuelling system
candidate_classifications.reason: The public artifact is a thesis PDF for a residential CFD study, not a station-to-vehicle synchronized pressure-temperature-flow logger archive.

candidate_classifications.title: Experimental and numerical investigations of supercritical cryogenic sprays
candidate_classifications.reason: The record contains a cryogenic spray paper only; it does not provide compressed-gas HRS station-to-vehicle process traces.

candidate_classifications.title: Numerical study of hydrogen explosions in a refuelling environment and in a model storage room
candidate_classifications.reason: The record has no downloadable data files and describes numerical explosion scenarios rather than synchronized station-to-vehicle measurements.

claim_boundary: Discovery evidence only. No candidate is promoted to an independent full-loop validation holdout without synchronized required channels, initial conditions, protocol metadata, file hashes and reuse terms.
next_action: Keep the independent full-loop gate open and request a de-identified logger export from a station-data custodian; freeze provenance and scoring before reading numerical outcomes.
